simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שַׁכּוּל (H7909) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שַׁכּוּל (shakkûwl) means bereaved First listed occurrence: 2Sam 17 8.

definitions.full: H7909. shakkuwl [ שָׁבוּל ] adjective childless (through bereavement); — feminine singular שְׁכוּלָה Isa 49:21 (figurative of Zion); — on form see Ba NB 47 . שַׁכּוּל adjective bereaved, robbed of offspring (Ba § 37 c ); — especially שׁ ׳דֹּב 2Sam 17:8 ; Hosea 13:8 ; Prov 17:12 (simile of fierceness); שַׁכֻּלוֺת נְשֵׁיהֶם Jer 18:21 ; בָּהֶם אֵין שַׁכֻּלָה Song 4:2 (of flock, in simile) = 6:6 .
